checks: Parent-first form filters roles, required markers are red stars, password mismatch/weak values are rejected, credentials are stored without plaintext and remain pending until activation
Activated account signs in with its initial password, custom current-password confirmation works, hierarchy and crafted reset actions cannot manage a superior
Management password reset accepts new credentials, rejects old credentials after success, preserves account status and rolls back completely on storage failure
Highest-only global role matrix is separate from individual-account editing; inherited accounts update together, explicit exceptions remain isolated, failure is atomic and defaults survive reload
Forgot-password Demo code is required, reset persists and invalidates the old password, and resetting a disabled account never activates it
